name: bare-abort-controller

exports.name: AbortController
exports.description: Controller object that lets you abort one or more operations via its linked `AbortSignal`.

members.name: AbortController
members.description: Create a new `AbortController` with a fresh, unaborted `AbortSignal`.

members.name: abort
members.description: Abort the controller's signal, notifying every listener with the given `reason`.

params.name: reason
params.description: The reason to abort with; passed to every `'abort'` listener and exposed as the signal's `reason`. Defaults to an `AbortError` when omitted.

exports.name: AbortSignal
signatures:
interface AbortSignal {
  readonly aborted: boolean
  readonly reason: any
  throwIfAborted(): void
  toJSON(): { aborted: boolean; reason: any }
  addEventListener(
    type: string,
    callback: EventListener,
    options?: AddEventListenerOptions | boolean
  ): void
  removeEventListener(
    type: string,
    callback: EventListener,
    options?: RemoveEventListenerOptions | boolean
  ): void
  dispatchEvent(event: Event): boolean
}
exports.description: Signal object that reports whether an operation has been aborted and why.

members.name: aborted
members.description: Whether the signal has been aborted.

members.name: AbortSignal.abort
members.description: Return a new `AbortSignal` that is already aborted with the given `reason`.

params.name: reason
params.description: The reason the returned signal is aborted with. Defaults to an `AbortError` when omitted.

members.name: AbortSignal.any
members.description: Return a new `AbortSignal` that aborts as soon as any of the given `signals` abort, with the same reason.

params.name: signals
params.description: The signals to observe; the returned signal aborts with the reason of whichever aborts first, or immediately if one is already aborted.

members.name: AbortSignal.timeout
members.description: Return a new `AbortSignal` that aborts with a `TimeoutError` after `ms` milliseconds.

params.name: ms
params.description: The number of milliseconds to wait before the returned signal aborts with a `TimeoutError`.

members.name: reason
members.description: The reason the signal was aborted, or `undefined` if it hasn't been.

members.name: throwIfAborted
members.description: Throw the signal's abort reason if the signal has been aborted, otherwise do nothing.

members.name: toJSON
members.description: Return a plain object with the signal's `aborted` and `reason` values.
